children: Sohu.com Limited reported Q3 revenue of $133M, down 26% year over year, and a GAAP net loss of $15M versus net income of $9M a year earlier. Cash, equivalents, short-term investments and long-term time deposits totaled approximately $1.2B.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
GAAP net loss $15M vs. $9M net income YoY
The company swung to a loss from profit, a clear deterioration in bottom-line performance.
Revenue $133M, down 26% YoY
The sharp annual decline signals continued pressure on the overall business.
Online game revenue $114M, down 30% YoY
Games accounted for most revenue, and the segment's contraction drove much of the reported decline.
Marketing revenue $15M, up 10% YoY
Growth in marketing services partially offsets the contraction in online games.
Liquidity totaled approximately $1.2B
The reported liquidity provides a substantial balance-sheet resource; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Repurchased 10.1M ADSs for about $134M
Repurchases used most of the previously announced $150M program limit, reducing remaining authorization.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a quarterly update showing a return to a year-over-year net loss and continued revenue contraction, while marketing services grew. The next catalyst is Sohu's Q4 2026 results, which will show whether revenue declines persist and whether marketing growth continues.
